common.fallbackLink: If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser:
common.footer: You get this email because you have a GnomeVPN account.

verify.subject: Confirm your GnomeVPN email
verify.preview: Confirm your email to finish signing up for GnomeVPN
verify.heading: Confirm your email
body: Confirming your address lets us restore access to the account if you ever forget your password — and it is where payment and renewal notices go.

reset.subject: GnomeVPN password reset
reset.heading: Password reset
body: We received a request to change your password. This link is valid for a limited time.
If you did not ask for this, ignore the email — your password stays as it is.

change.subject: Confirm your new GnomeVPN email
change.preview: Confirm your new GnomeVPN email address
change.heading: Email change
body: You asked to change your address to {email}. Confirm it to sign in with the new one from now on.
If this was not you, ignore the email — your address stays as it is.

paid.subject: Payment received — GnomeVPN is active until {date}
paid.heading: Payment received
body: Your GnomeVPN subscription is active until {date}.
No servers in your app? Open it and refresh the subscription.

renewed.subject: GnomeVPN renewed until {date}
renewed.heading: Subscription renewed
body: We charged {amount} RUB, and the subscription is active until {date}.
No servers in your app? Open it and refresh the subscription.
You can turn auto-renewal off in your account.

renewSoon.subject: GnomeVPN auto-renewal coming up: {amount} RUB
renewSoon.heading: Renewal coming up
body: Your subscription runs until {date}. A day before that we charge {amount} RUB to the card {card} and it renews.
Do not want to renew? Turn auto-renewal off in your account before the charge — access stays until the end of the paid term.

chargeFailed.subject: We could not charge your card for GnomeVPN
chargeFailed.heading: The card could not be charged
body: Access works until {date}. Renew by hand — another card works too.
We will not try to charge again this period.

endingSoon.subject: Your GnomeVPN subscription ends on {date}
endingSoon.heading: Your subscription ends soon
body: It runs until {date}. Renew it so your access does not stop.

trialEndingSoon.subject: Your GnomeVPN free day is almost over
trialEndingSoon.heading: The free day is almost over
body: Subscribe so your access does not stop — the time left on the free day is kept.

expired.subject: Your GnomeVPN subscription has ended
expired.heading: The subscription has ended
body: Access is off. Subscribe to bring it back — the link in your app starts working again.
